provenance: Independently authored full 46-scene Canvas reconstruction of Apointa voice agent film: ringing and missed call, animated conversation, weekly calendar booking, four typed lead answers, leads table/detail/recording, analytics counters/chart/scroll/call logs, service/date/time selection, confirmation, sharing modal and vector brand. One isolated QR crop only; no source UI, video or full-frame sequence loaded. Original soundtrack comparison only.
editable: project.json chronology, palette, marks and business data;composition.js dedicated UI geometry, animation and camera
questions: What's going on with your system?
When would you like a technician to come by?
answers: AC is running but blowing warm air. Unit is about 12 years old.
differences: Typography is a close Geist substitute; exact source font weights, tracking and glyph contours are not recovered.
All source app chrome, icons, tables, calendar appointments and controls are code-redrawn; small geometry, truncation and shadows differ.
Call-card scaling, ringing, missed notifications, waveform, message typing and blur transitions use authored timing and curves rather than recovered source animation.
Calendar/lead zoom anchors and dashboard scroll are authored; event outlines, toast overlap and chart line peaks differ.
Booking form row geometry, cursor press, confirmation transition and final brand reveal differ in fine spacing/timing.
One isolated original QR code is used as a static texture with provenance; no source browser screenshot/video or complete frame sequence is used.
Displayed dates, counts, offers and product claims reproduce the observed film only and are not verified current product facts.
Original reference soundtrack is comparison-only, not independently authored.
